integrity: Finite exact-integer proof via independent rook polynomial and word-count recurrences, plus direct small-order permutation tests; standalone verification source included.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-order cutoff through n=19, not an all-order periodicity theorem. Comparisons are bounded; original 2000 publication has a month but no independently verified first-publication day, while the cited 2014 arXiv source has an exact first-public date. The 2010 related work could not be inspected in full. No independent scientific audit performed.
title: First period-four failure in Fourier recovery of permutation excedance sets
